propositions: The N=3000 import benchmark invokes git config user.name lookup 6,000 times (once per envelope) via append_event->author()->_git_config, consuming 47.79s; this lookup should be cached once per import context.

The batch_stage_and_commit path calls sweep_stale_staging once per CREATE ticket (3,000 times), rescanning the same staging root while earlier items remain unpublished; this should sweep at most once per batch.
Import-scoped author caching via contextvar must be fallback-keyed, nestable, reset in finally, and never leak across independent interactive writes or sessions.
Stale-staging sweep must be bounded to the first new ticket in each batch; empty batches and existing-ticket-only batches must not introduce a new sweep.
Direct callers of stage_event and interactive writes must retain live author lookup and per-item sweep behavior; only the bulk import path is optimized.
The locked N=3000 contract (3,000 creates, 3,000 comments, exactly 24 commits, >=10x reduction, crash-resume, rollback) must remain unchanged; identical logical state and event bytes are required.
